verdict.rationale: Deel provides an official MCP server exposing platform actions (create time-off, list contracts, compare EOR costs) so AI agents like Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor can operate it via natural language, with OAuth2 handled automatically by most clients. However, this is all vendor documentation with no independent/community validation of real-world natural-language usage, and other community feedback highlights rigid workflows and poor handling of exceptions, raising doubt about how flexible true natural-language control is in practice.
